about: Kalshi x Polymarket twin markets. Only 'approved' pairs are traded. Each approved pair's rules were read side by side (event, outcome definition, deadline and time zone, resolution source, early-close/death/cancellation clauses). poly_outcome_for_kalshi_yes = the Polymarket outcome that wins exactly when Kalshi YES wins. Rejected pairs are never proposed again.

approved.note: Same source (Arkham Satoshi entity, Outflow or Swaps), same end Dec 31 2026 11:59 PM ET. Small risk: only Polymarket has a fallback if Arkham goes offline.
